selection: First source by seed/seat with any within-window action change; never by observed reward
change: Only the not-watered WATER-job eligibility predicate in an in-memory pinned FeedPolicy fork
null_control: Exact same-state null-fork versus original action equality on every screen/pilot callback
endpoint_control: Reference trajectory reproduces recorded source through step 718 and notebook10 final rewards
conservative_stop: Stop if any of own cash, coin margin, or local match score decreases; report tradeoffs explicitly

representation: 30 per-plant descriptors and 11 summaries; several are existing primitives, not all novel
